import json
from tests.unit.core.test_workspace_document_mutation_client_m5 import dav_server, creation_responses, collection_xml, CONTENT
from tests.unit.core.test_workspace_document_read_client_m2 import resource, multistatus
from core.workspace_document_nextcloud_mutation_client import NextcloudDocumentMutationClient
from core.workspace_document_paths import validate_document_path
from core.workspace_folder_nextcloud_client import NextcloudFolderClientConfig
responses=creation_responses()[:3]+[(207,{},collection_xml()),(207,{},multistatus(resource(),resource("Documents/X.md",collection=False,file_id="2")))]
authorized=[]
with dav_server(responses) as (base,seen):
 client=NextcloudDocumentMutationClient(NextcloudFolderClientConfig(base,"test","synthetic"))
 target=validate_document_path("Documents/X.md",format="markdown")
 assert client.inspect_create_target("Scope",target)==()
 def guard(method,path):
  authorized.append(method)
  return True
 result=client.create_document("Scope",target,CONTENT,confirmed_collections=(),before_mutation=guard)
 assert result.state=="known_failure" and result.reason_code=="document_target_collision"
 assert authorized==[] and len(seen)==5 and all(x[0]=="PROPFIND" for x in seen)
 print(json.dumps(dict(cases=1,passed=1,requests=len(seen),mutations=0,callback_calls=0,state=result.state,reason_code=result.reason_code,scenario="collision_after_initial_inspection")))
